# CHOIVE

> CHOIVE shows how AI sees a business, which competitors appear instead, why the business is being overlooked, and what to change.

Website: https://choive.com/
Run a diagnostic: https://choive.com/#diagnostic
Method: https://choive.com/methodology
CHOIVE Report: https://choive.com/report
Contact: hello@choive.com

## The problem CHOIVE solves

Buyers now ask Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini which business to choose.

Many strong businesses are missing from those answers. Their competitors appear instead.

Most AI visibility tools only count mentions. CHOIVE goes further. It checks the business evidence behind the result and shows what must improve.

## What CHOIVE delivers

CHOIVE records answers from four AI provider APIs using real buyer questions.

It checks the business website, public sources, reviews, independent coverage, customer evidence, structured information, and competitors.

It then delivers:

- a CHOIVE Score out of 100;
- four scores for Clarity, Trust, Difference, and Ease;
- the evidence behind every awarded point;
- the AI providers that mentioned the business;
- the companies named in place of the business;
- a verified head-to-head competitor;
- a wider market competitor;
- the strongest problems to fix first;
- ready-to-use website assets; and
- a clear action plan with completion checks.

## Why CHOIVE is different

CHOIVE is not only an AI mention tracker.

Mention trackers show what happened. CHOIVE explains the public evidence connected to the result and gives the business practical work it can complete.

Every awarded score point has a rule and an evidence record. Missing or unavailable evidence does not earn invented points.

AI provider recommendations stay separate from competitor research. A company named by one AI answer does not automatically become the verified head-to-head competitor.

This makes CHOIVE a diagnostic system, not a dashboard of changing AI answers.

## The CHOIVE Score

The CHOIVE Score measures four parts of the business's public evidence.

### Clarity — 25 points

Can a buyer quickly understand what the business offers, who it serves, and where it operates?

### Trust — 25 points

Can a buyer find reliable public proof such as reviews, customer results, credentials, partnerships, or independent coverage?

### Difference — 25 points

Can a buyer find a specific and supported reason to choose this business over another one?

### Ease — 25 points

Can people and automated systems find, read, connect, and check the business information online?

## Free diagnostic

The free diagnostic gives a fast verdict on the business.

It shows the CHOIVE Score, the four pillar scores, recorded AI-provider coverage, the main competitor finding, and the most important evidence gap.

No account is required.

## Full analysis

The paid analysis turns the diagnostic into a clear business improvement plan.

It includes:

- the complete score evidence;
- the questions asked and answers recorded;
- competitor intelligence;
- a side-by-side competitor comparison;
- priority actions in the correct order;
- a 30, 60, and 90-day plan;
- homepage headline options;
- a ready-to-use meta description;
- an llms.txt draft;
- JSON-LD structured data for developer review; and
- a customer evidence template.

The business receives work it can use, not only observations.

## CHOIVE Report

The CHOIVE Report is a complete branded PDF built from the saved diagnostic evidence.

It is designed for owners, leadership teams, agencies, investors, and partners who need a clear document they can review and act on.

## Competitor intelligence

Head-to-head competitor: the closest verified replacement for the same customer, offer, buying need, and serviceable market.

Market competitor: a business competing for the same customers, attention, or budget without being an exact replacement.

AI-named alternative: a company named in a completed provider answer. CHOIVE records it under the provider that named it.

These roles remain separate so the business can see what each competitor actually represents.

## Ready-to-use assets

CHOIVE turns evidence into practical website materials.

Each asset is written for the diagnosed business using the facts collected during that run. The business reviews the facts before publication.

The assets help the business explain itself more clearly, publish stronger proof, and make important information easier to verify.

## Who CHOIVE serves

CHOIVE can diagnose:

- local businesses;
- professional services;
- online shops;
- restaurants and hotels;
- software and technology companies;
- manufacturers;
- creators and personal brands;
- products and services;
- charities and organizations; and
- national and global companies.

CHOIVE supports local, regional, national, international, and global markets.

## Measurement note

CHOIVE records provider API answers during each diagnostic. Public AI apps may answer differently, so CHOIVE reports the source and status of each measurement clearly.

## One sentence

CHOIVE shows where a business is losing AI visibility, explains the evidence behind it, and provides the work needed to improve.
